projects.name: IssuePilot
projects.focus: Web application, access control & data integrity
projects.body: Issue tracker with a JavaScript interface, FastAPI and SQLite. Search, filters, role-based access and transactional history. Version checks reject stale edits; tests cover concurrent requests, two browser sessions and rollback on storage failure.

projects.name: LinePulse
projects.body: Simulation with a browser dashboard, FastAPI and SQLAlchemy persistence. Synthetic events feed metrics, rule-based alerts and Excel reports. Tests check calculations, API behaviour and user flows.

projects.name: Service Observability Lab
projects.body: FastAPI job-state API with a JavaScript dashboard. Persistent idempotency supports safe retries without duplicate records; tests cover SQLite and PostgreSQL. Separate health/readiness checks, Prometheus metrics and Docker Compose integration.

projects.name: OpsReportAutomator
projects.body: Python CLI validates CSV/Excel input, aggregates data by day and department, and generates a four-sheet Excel workbook with charts plus an HTML report. Pandas and OpenPyXL; tests check calculations and generated workbook structure.
